story_type: disabled shrimp trawler in breaking surf off a beach, four men hoisted by helicopter
hook: A fishing boat stuck in the breakers with four men aboard.
narration: This disabled fishing boat was rolling in the surf off Duck, North Carolina, with four men aboard.
Breaking waves were washing right around the hull, just off the beach houses.
The Coast Guard launched a Jayhawk from Air Station Elizabeth City, and a forty-seven-foot lifeboat from Oregon Inlet.
In surf this shallow, a helicopter is often the safer tool, because a boat coming alongside can be thrown into the hull by the same waves.
This is the view from the helicopter as it held over the trawler.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted all four men and flew them to the air station. No injuries were reported.
title: Fishing boat stuck in the surf, 4 aboard
description:
On Dec. 7, 2021, a Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew hoisted four fishermen from a disabled fishing vessel off the coast of Duck, North Carolina. No injuries were reported.
